summary: Validated the refactor (25 MongoDB indexes at startup + Visual chart CSS-relative container + dead-code removal in routes/thesis.py) did NOT break Google login/session or cloud sync. Auth via Bearer token still works. Cloud sync Nivel 2 (watchlist add/persist/remove) and Nivel 1 (portfolio GET) work. All key pages render without runtime errors. Visual chart container height is 460px on portrait and width grows CSS-only from 324→714 when viewport widened from 390→844 without reload. Backend index startup log confirms 25 indexes across 16 collections.

cloud_sync_nivel2_watchlist.reload_persistence: MSFT row still in Nivel 2 table (4 empresas)
cloud_sync_nivel2_watchlist.note: The 'Añadir' button next to the top search input is the search-and-navigate button (navigates to company page), NOT a direct add-to-watchlist button. Actual add uses the company page's 'Añadir a Nivel 2' button. This is existing UX behavior, not a regression.

key_pages_bearer_session./watchlist: loads, shows Nivel 2 with 3 seeded companies
key_pages_bearer_session./visual: loads, no page errors, chart renders
key_pages_bearer_session./thesis: loads, no page errors (only pre-existing hydration warning about <span> inside <option> in ThesisSidebar select — unrelated to refactor)

visual_chart_responsive.verdict: CSS-driven expansion working. Height is fixed at 460px (max-h-[460px]) as intended; width flexes with viewport.

detailed_results.index_startup: Backend log: 'MongoDB indexes ensured (25 indexes across 16 collections).' matches spec.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py _ensure_indexes: non-unique indexes and try/except per index — safe/idempotent. Good choice using compound indexes on (user_id, id) / (user_id, type) matching the actual query patterns in auth.py and routes/thesis.py.

Visual.jsx chart container uses h-[60vh] min-h-[300px] max-h-[460px] with ResponsiveContainer height=100% — clean CSS-only solution; the removal of the JS chartH useEffect is verified: width flexes 324→714 on resize with no reload and no JS error.

Minor pre-existing (unrelated to this refactor): ThesisSidebar has a <select> option that renders <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option>, causing React hydration warning 'In HTML, span cannot be a child of option'. Not blocking but should be cleaned up.

Recharts prints repeated console warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1)' on initial render; these come from hidden/unmounted chart containers and don't affect UX. Consider gating render behind isVisible if noise reduction desired.

auth.py watchlist tombstone logic (_merge_tombstones/_apply_tombstones) works but is fragile: entries without saved_at (which the API accepts as Optional) can be silently dropped if a matching tombstone exists. Consider setting saved_at=now server-side when client omits it, or documenting that clients MUST send saved_at.
updated_files: cleared residual MSFT/TSLA/WBTNF tombstones from user_watchlists for test_profile_user_123 during testing

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all key pages + watchlist add/persist/remove + visual chart responsive)

test_credentials: Bearer localStorage 'vs:token'='test_profile_token_fixed_123' (seeded profile user_id=test_profile_user_123, email=profiletest@example.com). Cookie is NOT required — the Authorization: Bearer header path via lib/api.js interceptor works.
seed_data_creation: Re-ran /app/backend/tests/seed_profile_test.py to ensure baseline. Cleared user_watchlists.deletions for test user to allow deterministic MSFT re-add.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bearer auth path is fully working; use localStorage 'vs:token'='test_profile_token_fixed_123' (must be set AFTER first navigation then reload). The correct UX to add a ticker to Nivel 2 is via /company/{TICKER} → 'AÑADIR A NIVEL 2' button — NOT via the top search bar 'Añadir' button (which is a search-and-navigate). Cleanup uses POST /api/auth/watchlist/delete {ticker}. Watchlist tombstones can persist across tests — clear user_watchlists.deletions map to reset. 25 MongoDB indexes are created on startup (see server.py _ensure_indexes).
rca of the issue: N/A — refactor is clean. All auth, cloud sync, key pages, and responsive chart behavior verified.
